title: A Landfall for the Passage
author: Zephyrine Villalobos
blurb: Sable Delacroix, a bush pilot flying medicine and rumors into the interior, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the dry season ends.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
